recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reopen only if a future generated definitions page drops the strength display again; in that case, fix the active Kindling/publisher renderer rather than editing generated HTML or duplicating binding text in resource source files.
issue_request: FHIR-19291 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request raised against STU3 and applied for R5. It asked that definitions-page binding descriptions display the binding strength display term, such as Required, Extensible, Preferred, or Example; the Jira comment summarized this as adding binding strength into descriptions of bindings.
initial_application: No current core-source commit was found that explicitly mentions FHIR-19291 or GF#18272. Historical Java definition-page rendering code was present in the FHIR repository before the old IG publisher was removed, but current source no longer contains that renderer and instead depends on the external Kindling build package.
additional_context: FHIR-18272, the related VHDir ballot comment, was closed Resolved - No Change because the missing strength labels were identified as an IG-publishing issue and the commenter was directed to the tooling/pub tracker that became FHIR-19291. Current core source carries binding strengths in ElementDefinition.binding.strength, and both the R5 published Observation definitions page and the current CI build render bindings with the value set followed by a strength display link.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current built specification satisfies the requested output, and the remaining rendering logic is owned by the external Kindling/publisher dependency rather than by editable core source files in this checkout.

related_jiras.note: The VHDir issue identified the same missing binding-strength display as an IG-publishing problem and directed submitters to the FHIR-19291 tooling/pub tracker, but it was a FHIR-vhdir no-change issue and is not decided here.
